tierReasoning: Small reversible fix: a silent drop becomes a recorded signal plus one attention item; no new authority, no persistent state; a revert fully undoes it.

guardEvidence.howCaught: The conflict notice fires at most once per (pr, head): the service keeps one open conflict per PR and returns early for the same head, and createAttentionItem is idempotent by id across restarts; it is driven only by a finished verify record (no tick), so its steady state is zero emits with no new pushes. The change also removes the automatic re-run for conflict records, so the registered local-verify-error-rerun controller only emits less (its convergence test still bounds it).
